title: Headless TTW Scientific Pursuits (MQ03): from Three Dog's goodbye (MQ02 200) through Doctor Li in Rivet City, Dad's holotape at Project Purity and Vault 112 into the Tranquility Lounger (stage 200, completed; MQ04 5)

actions.text: Start: MQ02 at stage 50 (the relay fixed, as ttw-mq02-galaxy-news-radio leaves it before Three Dog's goodbye; MQ01 and CG04 completed). Three Dog's goodbye line (MQ02ThreeDogCT04, 0x0A02445C) is said as the stand-in for the end of that chain: its end script completes MQ02 (200), whose stage starts MQ03 (0, then 10: find Doctor Li).
Rivet City: the player boards the ship (MQ03Script: in cell RC, stage 20) and finds Doctor Li in the science lab.

Onto the ship: the shore and Rivet City's deck are joined only by the swing bridge (RCExBridge1Ref, an animated activator the Security Intercom RCBridgeIntercomRef swings); no navmesh crosses it, so `fnvtool nav path` finds no way from the intercom to Doctor Li and one from the deck's RCGuardPostBridgeMarker [observed]. The player walks to the intercom; the crossing is the stand-in (MoveTo the deck marker).
Doctor Li's conversation: the player asks about Dad until she names the old lab at the Jefferson Memorial (MQ03LiOldLabLocation's end script, stage 30), then leaves the conversation.
Project Purity at the Jefferson Memorial: within 3000 units of MQ05ControlRoomMarker (MQ03Script, stage 40); the super mutants inside are the pilot's fights.
Dad's last holotape in the control room: taking it (MQAPanelScript sees the note, stage 50) and playing it from the Pip-Boy (its line's end script sets holoread and stage 60: Vault 112).
Vault 112: the robobrain's welcome gives the Vault 112 suit (stage 65); the player puts it on (VaultSuit112Script's OnEquip, stage 70).

The Tranquility Lounger: the player sits in it (activation). Engine gap: MQ04PlayerPodScript waits for GetSitting 3 near the pod, and the headless runner has no step that seats the player, so MQ04's playerinchair is set to 2 as the stand-in for the pod closing (what the pod's script sets after its 14 s). MQ04Script then moves the player into Tranquility Lane; 3 s later it sets MQ03 200 (completed) and MQ04 5.
